statement.excerpt: Regardless of how well it works (it works very very poorly and inconsistently), it's also likely very expensive.
statement.document_title: The Hater's Guide To The AI Bubble

from_speaker: it works very very poorly and inconsistently
our_interpretation: The performance claim concerns the launch version discussed in the post, from its July 17 announcement through July 21, 2025.
The ordinary reading is that it frequently fails ordinary advertised tasks and cannot reliably repeat successful results. No numerical failure threshold is supplied.
Expensive refers to OpenAI's cost of operating the agent, given the preceding discussion of virtual machines. Subscription prices do not establish that cost.
The cost assertion is hedged and supplies neither a comparison nor an accounting basis.
criteria.support_condition: Representative independent tests of the launch version show frequent material failures and unreliable repeated performance on advertised tasks. The cost component additionally requires attributable operating-cost evidence and a defensible comparison.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative independent repeated-task tests show dependable completion of ordinary advertised tasks. Low measured operating costs relative to an appropriate comparison would weigh against the cost component.
